A transverse wave on a string has a speed of $500 \text{ ms}^{-1}$.
The horizontal distance between two points P and Q on the wave is $4.0 \text{ m}$, as shown in the diagram.
At time $t = 0 \text{ ms}$, point X on the string is at its maximum displacement of $6.0 \text{ mm}$ above equilibrium.
What is the displacement of point X at time $t = 7.0 \text{ ms}$?
